Definition: from the same as G4467; recklessness, i.e. (by extension) malignity:--mischief.
BiblicalUsage: Paul said to Elymas the sorcerer, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that mischief is the right word for a man who perverts the straight ways of God into crooked ones.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
